title: Phenobarbital for Acute Alcohol Withdrawal
brief_summary: Intravenous phenobarbital in combination with a symptom-guided standardized lorazepam-based alcohol withdrawal protocol will be associated with decreased need for ICU admission, continuous lorazepam infusion and will not be associated with increased adverse events.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Need for admission to hospital for acute alcohol withdrawal

Exclusion Criteria:

* allergy to phenobarbital, lorazepam, age\<18 or \>65
